value.why: @colyseus/schema: a ChangeTree per instance keeps only the latest op per field per tick, has a separate DELETE op for clearing a field, and addresses by a refId that is never reused.

tldraw store: RecordsDiff {added, updated:[from,to], removed} inverts trivially; every change carries source user|remote, and side effects receive the source; atomic() batches; per-sequence migrations refuse a too-new file.
Patches bubble up gaining a path segment per level (as lew42's hops do); each patch has an inverse; undo is one event per root action; no move op, so the Loro binding adds moveWithinArray.

Loro: one event batch per commit tagged by local|import|checkout plus an origin that is not persisted; MovableList stores Move{from,to,elem_id}; tree move events carry both the old and the new parent and index, with a fractional index.
Naming precedent: one add per model plus one update per call with changes {added, removed, merged}; reset swaps all without granular events.

Six gaps reproduced in node: a replayed line makes readers write (Ref re-path, auto-complete), one set() becomes one line per key, add drops child lists, an unset does not replay, after/type data collide, unknown verbs become data. Ranked fixes, op vocabulary, test specs.
